index.title: Welcome to the Garden
index.content:
Jack’s Digital Garden
A growing repository of evolving thoughts, creative writing, game theory research, and programming experiments.

Garden Key:
🌱 Seedling: Raw ideas, quick snippets, and quotes.
🌿 Budding: Outlined concepts, working prototypes, and developing drafts.
🌲 Evergreen: Settled mechanics, comprehensive guides, and mature reference notes.


🗺️ Areas of Focus
✍️ Writing & Craft

Fiction drafting, worldbuilding bibles, and EPUB export formatting.
Technical documentation, architecture notes, and narrative analysis.

🎲 Game Design & Theory

Decision spaces, payoff matrices, and player agency.
Interactive storytelling, branching dialogue, and environmental narrative design.

💻 Programming

Python logic prototypes, scripting utilities, and backend tools.
Explorations into lightweight game engines and new languages.

🛠️ Projects & Devlogs

Active builds, game design documents (GDDs), and experiment logs.
